text:
sabrina: Morning — quick ask. We're seeing a small uptick in inference telemetry in us-west2 (higher queue times). Planning a quiet window tonight 00:30-01:30 PT for infra patching. Can the allocation team confirm SKUs available for demo/edge lanes? Also cc @lee for RDMA-enabled nodes.

lee: On it. Current snapshot: 12 A100s total in us-west2, 8 with RDMA, 4 are reserved for production. So ~4 free for demos but only 2 with RDMA. link: https://telemetry.example.com/us-west2/slots :eyes:

sabrina: thanks. If we only have 2 RDMA, can we fallback to H100 preemptible for the demo pool? Need latency under 50ms for the walkthrough.

marco: H100 preemptible is an option but preempt risk is high overnight. Suggest we move one reserved A100 to demo for the hour, then move back after patching. Will need finance-ops signoff for cross-tenant charge.

finance-ops: @marco please file a short billing override (confluence quickform) and tag me. Approvals are fast for up to 2 hours.

ops-bot: Scheduled maintenance window created: ticket INF-4593, quiet window 2024-11-02T00:30:00-08:00 to 2024-11-02T01:30:00-08:00. No auto-evictions enabled during window.

lee: If we do move one A100, can someone run this quick smoke: `kubectl get pods -n demos -o wide | grep allocator` then `curl -s http://allocator.metrics/queue | jq .p50` — want to confirm p50 < 40ms.

tara: I can run the smoke at 00:20 PT and report back. If numbers look off, I'll flip the reserved pool.

sabrina: perfect. Tara pls post results here. Also reminder: tag vendor slack (#vendor-ops) if we need fast hotswap.

tara: smoke at 00:22 PT: p50=36ms, p95=72ms. RDMA path stable. I'll proceed to move one A100 to demo at 00:28 and monitor.

marco: thanks — I'll kick off the billing override now.

finance-ops: override filed: CON-7421, approved.

tara: swap done at 00:29. Allocator p50=33ms, p95=65ms. No errors. :thumbsup:

sabrina: awesome, closing loop — quiet window proceed as planned. tagging: @lee @marco @tara :rocket:
